function: RL-driven deep-unfolded robust WMMSE precoder for downlink MU-MIMO-OFDM: policy network generates compensation matrices and unfolding depth to maximize expected weighted sum rate under imperfect CSI (pp. 3-4).
system: TDD massive MU-MIMO-OFDM downlink, BS planar array Mt=64, K=5 to 20 users with Mr=2 antennas each, 3.5 GHz, 15 kHz spacing; no RIS (pp. 2, 4).
method: Deep unfolding of wideband SWMMSE plus RL policy network (Gaussian policy, CNN and fully connected layers) trained as contextual bandit with model-free SSCA-based RL (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa channels, 3GPP_38.901_UMa_NLOS scenario; users within 200 m radius moving at 120 km/h; CSI error from channel aging only, uplink estimate assumed accurate (p. 4).
test_conditions: Training data and split not stated. Testing: UMa NLOS, K=5 to 20 users, SNR 0 to 20 dB, six downlink blocks with growing channel aging (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned: WMMSE, wideband SWMMSE (5 iterations; 100 iterations as upper bound). Learned: PO-WMMSE Net, an earlier deep-unfolding precoder of the same authors (pp. 4-5, Fig. 3).
metrics: EWSR (bit/s) versus block, number of users and SNR; average unfolding depth; complexity order and operation count (pp. 4-5, Fig. 3, Table I).
complexity: Complexity orders and numerical values in Table I (p. 5): RLDDU-Net 1.26e6, PO-WMMSE Net 2.85e6, (S)WMMSE 2.31e7 for the setup of Fig. 3a.
q1_support: p. 4: "Channels are generated using the QuaDRiGa model [15]". The scenario is 3GPP_38.901_UMa_NLOS, so the standardized channel criterion is met.
q2_support: p. 4: "RL enables online adaptation". Qualitative statement only; Fig. 3 sweeps users, SNR and channel-aging block in one QuaDRiGa UMa NLOS scenario, and no training and test split or unseen-scenario test is reported.
q3_support: p. 4: "Baseline algorithms include wideband the SWMMSE [3], [4] and a wideband extension of PO-WMMSE Net [2]"; p. 1: "a small number of trainable compensation matrices". SWMMSE and WMMSE are non-learned; PO-WMMSE Net is the authors' earlier learned precoder; all compared on EWSR in Fig. 3.
q4_support: p. 5: "we present the computational complexity and numerical results of RLDDU-Net and the baseline in Table I". Table I gives the order of RLDDU-Net including its policy-network term and the value 1.26e6.
q5_support: p. 4: "Channels are generated using the QuaDRiGa model [15]". Channels come from a channel generator, not a released dataset; no link to code or data appears anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included, area 3: robust WMMSE precoder for MU-MIMO-OFDM, a deep-unfolded network whose compensation matrices and depth come from an RL policy (pp. 3-4). Title on page 1 matches the DOI. q2: no training and test split or held-out scenario is stated; online adaptation is only claimed (p. 4). q3: PO-WMMSE Net [2] has trainable compensation matrices (p. 1) and is by the same authors (p. 3, our prior work [2]). q4: Table I and Fig. 3 were read from the page image (p. 5). q5: QuaDRiGa is a generator, and no code or data link is given; reviewer may confirm.
